correctness.rationale: Stochastic Fubini and Itô isometry give exactly \(\operatorname{Var}(J)=1/20\), \(\operatorname{Cov}(J,X(x))=x^2(x^2-4x+6)/24\) and \(\operatorname{Cov}(J,X'(y))=y(y^2-3y+3)/6\). Scalar Gaussian conditioning gives posterior variance \(1/20-\max(F_\eta,G_\eta)\). Exact derivative factorizations establish unique global optimizers for each instrument, including the value location reaching the endpoint at \(\eta=1/24\) and the derivative optimum remaining strictly interior. The ratio \(G_\eta^*/F_\eta(1)\) is strictly increasing, is below one at \(\eta=1/24\) by a rational strict certificate, and tends to \(16/9\). This proves exactly one modality crossing; elimination gives the displayed sextic and isolated root. The standalone symbolic script checks the identities and 32,014 grid comparisons without substituting finite tests for the global proof.
